integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and independently reproducible finite tests. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One exogenous source and one initially empty habitat patch; deterministic single construction date; investment maps exponentially to colonization rate and is frozen afterward; constant local extinction; terminal occupancy only. Primary full text of the most closely related biodiversity-offsetting study was inaccessible; historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp single-crossing law for interest-financed habitat creation under colonization and extinction
